name: Sherven's Grain & Livestock
old_description: Since 1970, Sherven Sales, Inc has been family owned and operated.  We specialize in grain systems, grain handling equipment, livestock equipment, and trailers. We offer assembly and service of all the products we sell.
about:
Sherven Sales, Inc., based in Wahpeton, North Dakota, has been family-owned and operated since its founding in 1970. The company began as a supplier of agricultural equipment and has remained under family stewardship for over five decades.

The business supplies and assembles a range of farm equipment, including grain bins and handling systems, livestock handling equipment, and flatbed, enclosed, and stock trailers. It provides full assembly and ongoing service for every product it sells, operating as a full-service dealer for agricultural operations.

Sherven Sales serves grain farmers, livestock producers, and commercial grain-handling facilities across the region. Its customer base includes family farms and larger agricultural enterprises that rely on the company for equipment procurement, installation, and maintenance.

The company distinguishes itself through its long-standing family ownership and its commitment to assembling and servicing all equipment it sells, offering a single point of contact for agricultural equipment needs.
